_comment: Contour school codes the source CSV does not carry, plus entries the CSV refresh dropped that a code still points at. Everything here was in the list the form served before the CSV became the source of truth — dropping any of it would silently unassign a campus. Keyed by acara_id.
_replace_comment: Codes that replace the CSV code, keyed by acara_id. Camberwell Girls Grammar (and its Junior Campus) and Camberwell Grammar (boys) are two schools the CSV gives the one code Camberwell; AY27 UCAT classes group them apart (30 Sep 2026).
